audit.note: The attribution model is default-off and the golden fixture is byte-identical with it off. The attributed statistic counts the channel-transcript reads carrying an informative tumour signature, so the leukocyte compartment does not enter it. It is reported with the mutation channel's raw per-locus VAF as the denominator and with the sequencing-error floor removed from it, which is the participant's estimated tumour cfDNA fraction.
